summary: Beta-level as of v1.5.0. Core plugin loading, Ed25519 verification, manifest validation, capability negotiation, dependency resolution, hot-plug, health monitoring, and OCI registry are implemented. Four documentation-accuracy findings corrected. No [x] roadmap items lack code evidence.

findings.expected: Files plugin_loader.cpp, plugin_api.cpp, manifest_validator.cpp, plugin_signer.cpp exist in src/plugins/
findings.observed: None of these four files exist in src/plugins/. Dynamic loading is in plugin_manager.cpp; plugin_api.h is header-only; ManifestSchemaValidator is in plugin_interface.h; signing is in signed_plugin_repository.cpp and tools/plugin_signer/sign_plugin.py

Ed25519 signature verification is fully implemented in signed_plugin_repository.h/.cpp with key-pinning. PluginManager::verifyPlugin() (plugin_manager.cpp:135) calls it, NDEBUG-guarded. reloadPlugin() performs Phase-2 atomic TOCTOU-safe signature check before swap.

findings.expected: Links point to docs/plugins/PLUGIN_SECURITY.md, docs/plugins/PLUGIN_MIGRATION.md, docs/plugins/MANIFEST_SIGNATURES.md
findings.observed: docs/plugins/ does not contain these files. Correct paths: docs/de/plugins/PLUGIN_MIGRATION.md, docs/de/plugins/MANIFEST_SIGNATURES.md. PLUGIN_SECURITY.md does not exist anywhere.

findings.expected: 4 features listed: Manifest Signatures, Plugin Migration, RPC Framework, Image Analysis
findings.observed: Module has 15 headers, 10 source files, 13 implemented features. Missing from table: plugin_manager, plugin_registry, plugin_metrics, plugin_health_monitor, plugin_hot_plug_monitor, plugin_dependency_resolver, signed_plugin_repository, oci_registry_client, plugin_api, plugin_system_edition, self_healing_plugin. Ghost source reference to include/enterprise/analytics_plugins.h which does not exist.
